description: Voice.voiceIndex is mandatory, an integer 1..4, and is the SOLE voice identity. Array order has no meaning. voices are sorted by voiceIndex ascending on every write.
testName: validateScore rejects duplicate voiceIndex in the same measure

description: Voice 1 exists in every StaffMeasure. A StaffMeasure never has zero voices.
testName: validateScore rejects measure with empty voices array

description: Score.groups: StaffGroup[] exists (empty for migrated scores).
testName: rejects group whose partIds contains an id that is not a part with group-unknown-part

description: Part.midiChannel (0..15) and Part.shortName exist. Percussion=9, non-percussion pool, >15 warning, shortName fallback.
testName: assigns channel 9 to percussion and distinct non-percussion channels from [0..8, 10..15]

description: schemaVersion = 7. Storage keys, .sfscore extension, and envelope stay as listed in LEGACY_IDENTIFIERS.md.
testName: defines CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION as 7

description: Existing ids (voice ids, event ids, measure ids, override keys) are never regenerated.
testName: Item 2b: Invariant 6: existing voice, event, measure and override IDs are preserved unchanged after migration

description: schemaVersion is 6 after earlier migrations. Greater than 7 rejected with Turkish message.
testName: rejects schemaVersion 8 with Turkish message

description: Every StaffMeasure has at most 4 voices. Greater than 4 voices rejected with Turkish message naming measure.
testName: rejects measures with more than 4 voices with Turkish message naming measure

description: Work on a deep copy. The original object is never mutated.
testName: Item 2c: Step S1: the input object is not mutated during migration (deep-freeze verification)

description: For each StaffMeasure: voiceIndex = array position + 1 (1..4). Existing voice ids kept. Voices sorted by voiceIndex.
testName: migrates v6 files carrying 0-based, 1-based, and contradictory voiceIndex values to position + 1

description: If StaffMeasure missing or no voice 1, create voice 1 filled with rests using fill measure with rests helper.
testName: decomposes correctly and validates for 3/4

description: Newly created ids are DETERMINISTIC: derived from stable inputs with pure hash function. No randomUUID / Math.random.
testName: aborts migration with descriptive error and leaves input untouched when an ID collides

description: Part.midiChannel and Part.shortName per invariant 4.
testName: falls back to name <= 6 chars or first 4 chars + "." when instrument is unknown

description: groups = [].
testName: Item 2e: Undo back to load point keeps voiceIndex and groups intact

description: schemaVersion = 7.
testName: defines CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION as 7

description: Postcondition: validateScore(v7 score) returns no errors. Warnings allowed. If postcondition fails, abort.
testName: Item 2a: Fuzz/property test over 200 random valid v6 scores validates, is idempotent, round-trips, and preserves rendering

description: A tie across a barline connects the pitch in measure N to the matching pitch in the NEXT measure of the SAME voiceIndex.
testName: Item 2d: Section 4: ties and slurs preserve identical event connections across migration in multi-voice scores

description: Slurs keep their event ids and must stay inside one voice (validateScore).
testName: validateScore rejects ties or slurs that cross voices

description: Migrating a v6 score must not change which events a tie or slur connects.
testName: Item 2d: Section 4: ties and slurs preserve identical event connections across migration in multi-voice scores

description: Unique voiceIndex per StaffMeasure; at most 4 voices; voice 1 exists.
testName: validateScore rejects single voice with voiceIndex != 1

description: Per-voice tick sum equals the measure length (actualTicks when present).
testName: validateScore rejects voice whose event durations do not match measure length

description: Ties and slurs are intra-voice.
testName: validateScore rejects ties or slurs that cross voices

description: A StaffMeasure exists for every MeasureDef in every staff.
testName: validateScore rejects score when a StaffMeasure is missing for a MeasureDef

description: WARNING (not error): more than 15 non-percussion parts share channels.
testName: validateScore warns when more than 15 non-percussion parts share MIDI channels

description: A failed migration changes nothing: not the loaded file, not the autosave.
testName: Item 2f: Section 6: Failure policy P1 and P2 leave storage record and loaded input untouched

description: Unknown future versions (> 7) are rejected with a clear message.
testName: rejects schemaVersion 8 with Turkish message

description: Saving a migrated score writes schemaVersion 7; original v6 file is never overwritten unless user saves over it.
testName: Item 2f: Section 6: Failure policy P1 and P2 leave storage record and loaded input untouched

description: Real saved .sfscore fixtures for v1..v6 created through real app path migrate to valid v7 score.
testName: loads generated v6_generated.sfscore and migrates to a valid v7 score

description: Idempotent: migrating a v7 score again changes nothing; migrate(v6) twice gives byte-identical output.
testName: is idempotent: migrating a v7 score changes nothing, migrateV6ToV7 twice produces byte-identical JSON

description: Property/fuzz test over random valid v6 scores: validates, serialises/deserialises, 25 golden snapshots unchanged.
testName: Item 2a: Fuzz/property test over 200 random valid v6 scores validates, is idempotent, round-trips, and preserves rendering

description: Voice order: voices stored in different array order across measures keep same voiceIndex identity in migration and selection.
testName: FAILING-FIRST: asserts selection follows voiceIndex (1..4) regardless of array storage order across measures

description: Missing voice 1 in 3/4, 5/8, 7/8, and pickup measure with actualTicks: rests are valid.
testName: decomposes correctly and validates for 5/8

description: More than 4 voices in one measure: load rejected, input untouched, Turkish message.
testName: rejects measures with more than 4 voices with Turkish message naming measure

description: schemaVersion 8: rejected.
testName: rejects schemaVersion 8 with Turkish message

description: MIDI: 15 non-percussion parts get 15 distinct channels, none=9; 16-part reuses and emits warning; percussion gets 9.
testName: assigns channel 9 to percussion and distinct non-percussion channels from [0..8, 10..15]

description: Ties across a barline in voice 1 and in voice 2 survive migration unchanged.
testName: Item 2d: Section 4: ties and slurs preserve identical event connections across migration in multi-voice scores
